paite: Israel kumpipa, David tapa Solomon paunakte.
heading: Paunakte Manphatna

paite: Pilna leh hilhna theihna ding; theihsiamna thute theihkakna ding;
thilhih pilhuai a hilhna mu ding, diktatna, vaihawm leh hawmsiamna ah;
mimawlte kiang a kivensiamna pe ding, tangval kiang a theihna leh ngentelna.
Mipil in azak theih a, sinsiamna a apuntheihna ding in; theisiammi in thuphate aphaktheihna ding;
Paunak leh lim a thugen theisiam ding; mipilte thute, gentehna thugen theihhakte theisiam ding in.
TOUPA kihtak theihna kipatna ahi; himahleh mihai in pilna leh hilhna amusit.
heading: Tuailaite Thuhilhna

paite: Ka tapa, na pa hilhna za in, na nu dan mangngilh ke'n;
na lu a ding in deihhuai lutang zem leh na ngawng vial ding khainiangte hi ding ahi ngal a.
Ka tapa, mikhialte'n ahon zol ualeh, pha sakpih ke'n.
Hon zui in, sisan i buk ding ua, aziak bei in mihoihte aguk in i tang ding uh, achih uleh;
Sheol bang in amaute ahing in i nawmvalh ding ua, huan, kokhuk sung a paisukte bang in,
apum in van manpha tengteng i mu ding ua, gallakte in i innte uh i dimsak ding uh;
na tan kou lak ah na seplut ding a; sumbawm khat i neikhawm ding ua;
ka tapa, lampi ah amau toh ton ke'n; alampi ua kipan na khe kaikik in;
gilou hih ding in akhe uh atai ngal a, huan sisan suah ding in akinoh uhi.
Vasa himhim mitmuh in, len akiphah thawn ngal a,
huan hiaite'n amau sisan ngei atang ua, amau hinna ngei aguk in abuk uhi.
Huchibang tuh michih punna a duhgawlte lampi ahi a; huai in aneitute hinna alakmangsak sek hi.
Kongzing ah ngaihtak in pilna akikou a; mun liante ah a-aw asuah a;
heading: Pilna Akikou

paite: mipi omkhawmte munpipen ah akikou a; kongpite lutna ah, khopi ah, athute agen.
Bang tan ahia, nou mimawlte'n, mawlna na it ding uh? Nuihsan mite'n nuihsan a amaute akipah ding ua, mihaite'n theihna ahuat ding uh?
Ka salhna ah kihei unla; ngai in na tung uah ka kha ka sungbo ding, na kiang uah ka thute ka theisak ding hi.
Ka sap a, na nial ziak un; ka bante ka zak a, kuamah in alimsak kei uh.
Himahleh ka thupha tengteng bangmah lou in na koih ua, ka salhnate bangmah na deih kei uhi.
Ke'n leng na tuahsiat ni un ka hon nuihsan dia; na launa uh ahong tun chiang in ka hon chiamnuih ding;
huihpi bang a na launa uh ahong tun chiang in; pingpei bang a na tuahsiatna uh ahong tun chiang in; lungkhamna leh dahna na tung ua ahong tun chiang in.
Huai hun chiang in kei ahon sam ding ua, himahleh ka dawng kei ding; thanuamtak in ahon zong ding ua, himahleh ahon mu kei ding uh.
Theihna ahuat ua, TOUPA kihtakna azon louh ziak un,
ka thupha lak ah bangmah adeih kei ua; ka salhna tengteng amusit uhi.
Huaiziak in alampi uh gah ane ding ua, amau thusawmte ngei in avah ding uhi.
Mimawlte nungtolhna in amaute athat dia, mihaite hauhsakna in amaute hihmang ding ahih ziak in.
Himahleh kuapeuh kei hon ngaikhia bittak in ateng ding ua, gilou launa pang lou in amuang ding uhi.
